name: geekist-architecture-skills
description: Thirteen portable agent skills for clear project writing, evidence-led outreach research, authentic individual correspondence, technical documentation, decisions and product communication.

interface.shortDescription: Clear writing, research and authentic outreach
interface.longDescription: Write and revise project reports, research findings, technical documentation, architecture decisions and product content. Investigate commercial opportunities and write recipient-specific professional outreach grounded in actual relationships, current evidence and the author's editorial judgement. Shared writing principles preserve meaning without mandatory templates, sales sequences or unnecessary dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Research this company for credible collaboration or paid-work opportunities.
Write an individual founder email from these findings and the relationship history.
Polish this message so it sounds like the author, not a sales template.
Write up this project's technical investigation for the team.
